title: Amazon Is Giving You More Time to Shop During Black Friday. Here’s What’s on Sale
gist: Amazon's 'Black Friday Week' runs through November 30 (Cyber Monday); WIRED's picks show discounts largely clawing back 2026 price increases — e.g. the M5 MacBook Air, which now starts at $1,300 after Apple's hike, drops to near its pre-increase price — while gaming laptops have become more expensive this year and Pixel 11 phones hit Amazon lows.

insights.claim: Apple raised prices in 2026 so the once-affordable 13-inch MacBook Air (M5) now starts at $1,300; Amazon's Black Friday deal at $1,049 brings it close to its pre-increase price.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Black Friday discounts on Apple hardware are largely offsetting this year's list-price hikes rather than delivering real cuts — watch unit demand vs ASP.
insights.quote: When Apple raised prices earlier this year, the once-affordable MacBook Air now starts at $1,300.

insights.claim: The base Apple iPad (A16) Black Friday deal at $399 brings it closer to its MSRP before Apple's 2026 price increase.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Confirms Apple's 2026 price increases spanned multiple product lines.
insights.locator: The best iPad for most people

insights.claim: Gaming laptops, already expensive, became even more expensive in 2026; WIRED notes the RTX 5070 configuration of the Asus ROG Strix G16 is nearly $3,000.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Rising PC hardware prices point to component cost inflation (GPUs/memory) pressuring consumer PC demand.
insights.quote: Good gaming laptops are never cheap, and they’ve become even more expensive this year.

insights.claim: Amazon's 'Black Friday Week' sale runs until November 30 (Cyber Monday), extending the promotional window to give shoppers a head start.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Longer promotional windows spread holiday demand, blunting single-day sales spikes.
insights.locator: Amazon’s Black Friday deals are a go

insights.claim: Google's Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro and Pixel 11 Pro XL are at their lowest-ever Amazon prices ($699, $750, $899), and are the only non-iPhones supporting Qi2 wireless charging and magnetic mounting.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Aggressive Pixel discounting (up to 32% off) suggests Google is buying share in premium Android.
insights.locator: Pixel 11, Pixel 11 Pro, and Pixel 11 Pro XL

insights.claim: Soundcore, Anker's audio brand, is soon to be rebranded as Anker, its parent company.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Brand consolidation at Anker — minor corporate-strategy signal.
insights.quote: soon to be rebranded as Anker, its parent company

insights.claim: Amazon's own devices such as the Echo Show 11 ($155, 38% off) and Blink Mini Pan-Tilt 2K+ ($20, 60% off) carry some of the deepest Black Friday discounts, consistent with Amazon subsidizing ecosystem hardware.
insights.speaker: Les Shu
insights.so_what: Amazon continues to price first-party smart-home hardware aggressively to grow its Alexa ecosystem.
insights.locator: You can expect Amazon’s own devices to go on sale
